rules.statement: A sale of immovable property cannot be set aside on the ground of irregularity unless the applicant proves to the satisfaction of the court that he has sustained substantial injury by reason of such irregularity, and unless the grounds of the irregularity shall have been notified to the court within thirty days of the receipt of the Fiscal's report.
rules.supporting_quote: no sale shall be set aside on the ground of irregularity.....unless the grounds of the irregularity shall have been notified to the Court within thirty days of the receipt of the Fiscal’s Report
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 282 (2) of the Civil Procedure Code
